Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 8. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Pay and Accounts Officer, Cabinet Affairs payable at New Delhi . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Pay and Accounts Officer, Cabinet Affairs payable at New Delhi . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A. Bidder must submit agreement to ATC on their letter head and it should bear the latest date during th

e validity of the bid. Bidder may upload self-attested bid document. B. ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. C. Bidder must enclose GST return for the last 01 year i.e., 2025-26. D. The bidder should have registered with EPF and ESI department. Latest ESIC & EPF challan return alon g with ECRs for minimum 10 manpower for last 01 years to be enclosed with the bid. E. Service provider is required to submit certified copies of educational qualification certificates (Seconda ry School) to the buyer before starting of the contract. F. Company/ firm office in Delhi NCR (valid documents to be enclosed). G. This is two bid system and only those parties who qualify in the technical bid, their financial bid will be opened. H. Bidder is required to submit an undertaking in their letter head confirming that the firm has not been b lacklisted by any Central Government Department/Ministry, PSU, Bank, etc., during the preceding thre e years. Further, a separate undertaking regarding the firm’s financial standing is required, confirming that the firm is neither bankrupt nor under liquidation or court receivership, and that no similar procee dings are pending or contemplated before any court of law. Both undertakings should bear the latest d ate during the validity of the bid. I. Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any resp onsibility in this regard. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whicheve r is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. J. Duration of the service contract may be extended up to 6 months beyond the initial contract duration (subject to satisfactory performance and mutual consent). K. Additional documents will not be accepted after closing the bid or during the representation window. L. Bid specific documents are mandatory to be submitted. No exemption in this regard will be entertaine d. M. Bidders participating from same IP address will be rejected. . 13. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider
